names.es: Patatas al Ajillo Conscientes del Lugar (con retirada del ajo)

citation.source: Commonly cited culinary conversion: 1 pinch ≈ 1/16 tsp of fine table salt
citation.note: Same figure garlic-oil-potatoes.json's own identical salt instance already uses.

metadata.notes: The REAL, place-aware fix for the exact gap garlic-oil-potatoes.json's own removalNote named by id: 'no verb for physically remove this instance from the vessel... flagged rather than faked.' Built 2026-08-16 alongside data/actions/remove.json, mirroring fried-egg-shared-pan.json's own FILL/HEAT_PLACE/PLACE_IN pattern (not a replacement for garlic-oil-potatoes.json, which stays as-is — a deliberate sibling, same precedent as fried-egg-shared-pan.json alongside huevo-frito.json): oil is FILLed into pan-1 and HEAT_PLACEd to 175°C, garlic is PLACE_IN'd and FRIEd (oilTempC/placeId now genuinely checked, not just informational — recipe-runner.ts's assertPlaceReady requires pan-1 to actually be at FRY's own declared oilTempC minimum), the same still-frying garlic INFUSEs the oil, and THEN — the actual point of this recipe — REMOVE takes garlic-1 OUT of pan-1 before potato ever goes in, exactly matching the real technique's own instruction to not let it rest in the hot oil. potato-1 is PLACE_IN'd and FRIEd in the SAME still-hot, now garlic-infused oil.
metadata.removeProofNote: Checkable directly in the run log: after REMOVE, placeContents['pan-1'] no longer lists garlic-1 (the log's own 'now shared by [...]' line shows only potato-1 once it's placed) — garlic-1 is not exposed to any further HEAT_PLACE ticks in this recipe (there are none after removal, but the mechanism is real: a longer recipe with additional HEAT_PLACE steps after this point would correctly no longer heat garlic-1 at all). See scripts/remove-from-place-as-a-robot.ts for the direct proof of REMOVE's rejection path (removing something never placed, or already removed) — this recipe only proves the success path, since npm run validate's end-to-end simulation requires every step to succeed.
metadata.scopeNote: Deliberately does NOT attempt to also model 'idle time causes burning' (the adjacent, still-fully-open half of the same ROADMAP gap — see remove.json's own idleTimeScopeNote) — this recipe proves the REMOVAL mechanism works, not that skipping it would have been detected as a failure.
